needed.evidence: footway is too narrow and unusable, people walking in the road
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the left sidewalk to at least 1.5 metres width and ensure it is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: pedestrian barriers and stalls encroaching on the footway
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the right footway to ensure it is fully accessible for pedestrians.
Resurface and level the left sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: marked crossing that is not clearly visible and drivers may not stop
needed.suggestion: Install reflective markers and signal lights at the crossing to improve visibility and encourage drivers to stop.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing

needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to ensure proper illumination for both pedestrians and drivers.
